notes.title: We’re Making Our Next Game—Thanks to You! 💖
notes.content:
🎉 Thank you so much to everyone who gave Devil and Pitfall a try!

Your support — whether through reviews, messages, or just playing the game —
has meant the world to us.



💖 Because of you, we’re now officially working on our next game.
(Yes, it’s still going to be spicy. Probably even spicier…)



💬 If you haven’t left a review yet and feel like sharing your thoughts,
it would help us tremendously as we keep building this world!



🖼️ And to celebrate, here’s a little art drop:
Cool devil? Lovesick devil?

Either way, he’s all yours. Thanks for letting him into your heart. 💖



Thank you again. You’re Special exists because of you.

PS: If you’re posting art or impressions, tag it with #YoureSpecialGames — we love seeing your creations!


📣 Stay Connected
Want sneak peeks, dev notes, or spicy bonus art?
We’re most active on:

🔗 Tumblr
🔗 BlueSky

We’d love to see you there — and hear what made your heart race. 💘

notes.title: ✨ Devilishly Refined: English Update Now Live!
notes.content:
🔔 Update: The Devilishly Refined Edition is Here!😈💬
Hello again, Devil and Pitfall fans! 💖

We’ve got exciting news today: the English version has been thoroughly refined for a smoother, spicier experience from start to finish! 💅🔥

Some of you may remember that we were getting help from a native English speaker to polish up the translation.

While that collaboration started off great, schedules didn’t quite align long-term—so we decided to step back in and handle things ourselves, with care and lots of coffee. ☕😌

We’re incredibly grateful for the support we received along the way—and now we’re proud to share a freshly polished script that better captures the devil’s charm and the heroine’s unique voice.


🌟 What’s Changed?
* Every line—from the prologue to all endings—has been revised

* Dialogue and choices now feel smoother, sharper, and better aligned with each character’s tone

* No major story changes—but a whole lot more style 💃✨


🎭 Translation Glow-Up 🎭
Sometimes the devil just needed a little help expressing himself...

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049606/208b83e94b1a7c18c50d0b96cee8421736664f16.png"]Before: “The devil was a bit... too enthusiastic.” 😅



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049606/ac2436c211087a8127a778d7431ffb3737166855.png"]After: “Now he’s just the right amount of wicked.” 😈💬


 ❤️ Still Made with Love
We’re always striving to make this game the best it can be, one sultry smirk at a time. Your patience means so much to us.

We hope the refined English helps make every spicy scene—and emotional moment—even more fun to read!

As always, the devil's obsession remains completely intact. 😉🔥



With love and slightly tired eyes,

The You're Special Team 💘👹



🛍️ P.S. Thinking about picking it up (or replaying)?  

We might just have a little surprise coming soon...  

Keep an eye out for a devilishly tempting sale. 😈💸




🔄 Not seeing the new English script yet?
Steam should update your game automatically—but if you’re still seeing the old version, try restarting Steam, or:

* Right-click the game in your Library → “Properties” → “Installed Files” → Click **“Verify integrity of game files”**

This will force Steam to update any missing or outdated files. 💻✨

notes.title: Devilishly Exciting Update from the You're Special Team! 😈✨
notes.content:
Hey there, Devil and Pitfall fans! 👋 We've got some hot news that'll make your hearts flutter faster than our charming devil's wings! 🔥💗

Native English Check: Partial Completion 🎉

Remember when we mentioned we were working with a native English speaker? Well, guess what? They've been working their magic, and we're thrilled to announce that a portion of the English version has passed their expert scrutiny! 🌟🔍

What's New? 🆕

We've polished up all the scenes leading right up to where things start getting... interesting with our devilishly handsome love interest. 😏 That's right, we're talking about everything from your first encounter to the moment just before your relationship with that charming devil takes an exciting turn!

The Spicy Stuff 🌶️

Now, we know what you're all really waiting for - those tantalizing scenes that make Devil and Pitfall truly special. 😘 Rest assured, we're pouring our hearts (and a little bit of our souls) into making them absolutely perfect. They're still cooking, but trust us, they'll be worth the wait! 🔥⏳

Our Promise to You ❤️

Here at You're Special, we're having an absolute blast bringing this game to life. Your enjoyment means everything to us, and we're committed to delivering the best devil dating experience out there! If any issues pop up along the way, we'll tackle them faster than you can say "sweet temptation"! ⚡️

We're beyond grateful for your patience and support. You truly are special to us, and that's why we'll keep working tirelessly to ensure Devil and Pitfall exceeds your every expectation.

Stay tuned for more updates, and keep those pitchforks ready for more devilish fun! 😈🍴

With love and a touch of mischief,
The You're Special Team 💕👹

notes.title: Love Speaks All Languages: Major English Update for Devil and Pitfall! 💖🌍

While we had a few hiccups with the initial release (oops, our bad! 😅), we've given the entire English translation a complete overhaul. It's now smoother than your devilish love interest's pick-up lines! 😎💬 We're pretty confident it's a massive improvement, but hey, nobody's perfect - there might still be a few quirks hiding in there. 🙈

But wait, there's more! 🥁 We're incredibly fortunate to be collaborating with a dedicated native English speaker who's generously lending their expertise to give the game an extra polish. 🌟 Their invaluable insights are helping us ensure our devilish dialogue truly shines. We can't wait to share this ultra-refined version with you, but we're keeping the release date under wraps for now. Good things come to those who wait, right? 🤫⏳

Rest assured, we're not stopping here. Our team is having a blast working on Devil and Pitfall, and we're committed to making it the best devil dating experience out there. 💯 If any issues pop up, we'll tackle them faster than you can say "sweet temptation"! ⚡️

We pour our hearts (and a little bit of our souls) into this game, and your enjoyment means the world to us. 💖 Thank you for your patience and support - you truly are special to us! 🙏

Love,
